images.caption: Brisbane's City Hall's fountain was relocated from Albert Square during its redevelopment into King George Square. The fountain is centrepiece to a well-tended garden on the Corner House roundabout at the junction of Wynnum, Wynnum West and Manly West. Photo taken 29/12/05.
